name: rapid7-threat-command-cloud
label: Rapid7 Threat Command Cloud
description: Rapid7 Threat Command Cloud is a digital risk protection and external threat intelligence platform that helps organizations monitor, detect, and mitigate threats originating outside their perimeters (web, deep web, dark web).

fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Specify the URL of the Rapid7 server to connect and perform automated operations.
fields.name: url
fields.tooltip: Specify the URL of the Rapid7 server to connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Account ID
fields.description: Specify the account ID to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations
fields.name: account_id
fields.tooltip: Specify the account ID to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations

fields.title: API Key
fields.description: Specify the API Key to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations
fields.name: api_key
fields.tooltip: Specify the API Key to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.

operations.title: Get IOC Sources
operations.description: Retrieve a list of IOC sources from rapid7 threat command cloud server.

operations.title: Get IOCs by Filter
operations.description: Retrieve a list of IOC's from the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server based on the Last Updated From parameter you specified.

parameters.title: Last Updated From
parameters.description: Select a date and time to retrieve results that include only items last updated after the specified timestamp.
parameters.name: lastUpdatedFrom
parameters.tooltip: Select a date and time to retrieve results that include only items last updated after the specified timestamp.

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: Specify the number of records to skip when retrieving records from rapid7 threat command cloud server.
parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of records to skip when retrieving records from rapid7 threat command cloud server.

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.description: Specify the maximum number of results this operation should return, per page, in the response.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of results this operation should return, per page, in the response.

operations.title: Get IOC by Value
operations.description: Retrieve a specific IOC details from rapid7 threat command cloud server based on the IOC value parameter you have specified.

parameters.title: IOC
parameters.description: Specify the IOC value based on which you want to retrieve details from rapid7 threat command cloud server.
parameters.name: iocValue
parameters.tooltip: Specify the IOC value based on which you want to retrieve details from rapid7 threat command cloud server.

operations.title: Add IOCs to Source
operations.description: Add IOC's to the specified source in the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server using the provided source ID and IOC value parameters.

parameters.title: Source ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the source based on which you want to add IOC's.
parameters.name: sourceID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the source based on which you want to add IOC's.

parameters.title: IOCs
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of IOC's to add to the source in the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server.
parameters.name: iocs
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of IOC's to add to the source in the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server.

parameters.title: IOC
parameters.description: Specify the IOC value for which you want to update the severity in the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server.
parameters.name: iocValue
parameters.tooltip: Specify the IOC value for which you want to update the severity in the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server.

parameters.title: Severity
parameters.description: Select the severity level you want to assign to the IOC. Available options are: High, Medium, or Low.
parameters.name: severity
parameters.tooltip: Select the severity level you want to assign to the IOC. Available options are: High, Medium, or Low.

operations.title: Get CVEs by IDs
operations.description: Retrieve CVE details from the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server using the CVE IDs you provided.

parameters.title: CVE IDs
parameters.description: Specify the list of CVE IDs for which you want to retrieve details from the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server.
parameters.name: cveList
parameters.tooltip:
Specify the list of CVE IDs for which you want to retrieve details from the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server. For e.g [
    "CVE-1999-001",
    "CVE-1999-002"]

operations.title: Get CVEs List from Account
operations.description: Retrieve a list of CVEs from the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server based on the Publish Date From parameter you specified.

parameters.title: Publish Date From
parameters.description: Select a date and time to retrieve results that include only items published after the specified timestamp.
parameters.name: publishDateFrom
parameters.tooltip: Select a date and time to retrieve results that include only items published after the specified timestamp.

operations.title: Get Alerts List
operations.description: Retrieve list of alerts from the Rapid7 Threat Command cloud server based on the filter parameters you specified.

parameters.title: Alert Type
parameters.description: Select one or more alert type from the following options to filter alerts: "AttackIndication", "DataLeakage", "Phishing", "BrandSecurity", "ExploitableData", "vip"
parameters.name: alertType
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more alert type from the following options to filter alerts: "AttackIndication", "DataLeakage", "Phishing", "BrandSecurity", "ExploitableData", and "vip"

parameters.title: Severity
parameters.description: Select one or more severity from the following options to filter alerts: "High", "Medium", and "Low"
parameters.name: severity
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more severity from the following options to filter alerts: "High", "Medium", and "Low"

parameters.title: Source Type
parameters.description: Select one or more source type from the following options to filter alerts: "ApplicationStores", "BlackMarkets", "HackingForums", "SocialMedia", "PasteSites", and "Others"
parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more source type from the following options to filter alerts: "ApplicationStores", "BlackMarkets", "HackingForums", "SocialMedia", "PasteSites", and "Others"

parameters.title: Network Type
parameters.description: Select one or more network type from the following options to filter alerts: "ClearWeb", and "DarkWeb"
parameters.name: networkType
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more network type from the following options to filter alerts: "ClearWeb", and "DarkWeb"

parameters.title: Matched Asset Value
parameters.description: Specify the matched asset value to use when filtering alerts.
parameters.name: matchedAssetValue
parameters.tooltip: Specify the matched asset value to use when filtering alerts.

parameters.title: Tags
parameters.description: Specify the tags based on which you want to filter alerts.
parameters.name: tags
parameters.tooltip: Specify the tags based on which you want to filter alerts.

parameters.title: Remediation Status
parameters.description: Select one or more remediation status from the following options to filter alert: "InProgress", "Pending", "CancellationInProgress", "Cancelled", "CompletedSuccessfully", and "Failed"
parameters.name: remediationStatus
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more remediation status from the following options to filter alert: "InProgress", "Pending", "CancellationInProgress", "Cancelled", "CompletedSuccessfully", and "Failed"

parameters.title: Source Date From

operations.title: Execute an API Request
operations.description: Sends an API request to an API endpoint based on specified HTTP method, endpoint, and other input parameters that you have specified, enabling flexible API interactions tailored to user needs.

parameters.title: HTTP Method
parameters.description:
Select an HTTP action for the request. You can select from the following options: 

GET 

PUT 

POST 

DELETE 

PATCH 

HEAD 

OPTIONS 

TRACE
parameters.name: method
parameters.tooltip:

parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.description: Specify the target API URL path for the request. For example, if the website is https://example.com and URL path is https://example.com/images/pic.jpg, the endpoint would be /images/pic.jpg.
parameters.name: api_endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Should include the whole string eg: "/api/v1/helloworld"

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.description: Specify any optional parameters to add to the URL and refine the request.
parameters.name: params
parameters.tooltip: Specify any optional parameters to add to the URL and refine the request.

parameters.title: Request Payload
parameters.description: Specify data, as JSON, to be sent as the request payload (typically for POST or PUT requests).
parameters.name: json_data
parameters.tooltip: Specify data, as JSON, to be sent as the request payload (typically for POST or PUT requests).
